explanation: Reversing a comparison changes its denominator. If A is p% more than B, choose B=100 and A=100+p. The reverse percentage difference is100p/(100+p)%. If A is p% less than B, use A=100-p; the reverse excess is100p/(100-p)%. The reference must be positive.
